## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-10-09 — do not edit manually*

### Environment
*~5,000 tokens/session saved*
- Pipe verbose commands like `npx tsc --noEmit` through `cut -c1-300 | head -30` to cap output — this repo's TS errors can be extremely long; always truncate before letting output enter context.

### Editing Workflow
*~90 tokens/session saved*
- When applying multiple small fixes to the same file (e.g. `ProductCard.tsx`), make one Edit/Write call with all changes combined instead of 3+ sequential single-line edits — each separate Edit call re-sends the file context.
- For scripted text replacements across a file, use a `python3 - <<'E'` heredoc with `str.replace()` (already proven pattern in this repo) rather than multiple manual Edit calls.

<!-- headroom:learn:end -->
